{"id":2034567512,"question_id":3931,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781581595,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2034567512/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Process String with Special Operations I","memory":"39.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string processStr(string s) {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        bool hasletter = false;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            char ch = s[i];\n            if(isalpha(ch)) \n            {\n                ans += ch;\n                hasletter = true;\n            }\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '*') \n            {\n                ans.pop_back();\n                if(ans.empty()) hasletter = false;\n            }\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '#') \n            {\n                ans += ans;\n            }\n            else if(hasletter and ch == '%') \n            {\n                reverse(begin(ans) , end(ans));\n            }\n        }\n\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"process-string-with-special-operations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2138}
